dct_title_s: A sportsman's guide to the principal race courses in America : with plans and descriptions of twenty six major courses and an historical compendium of early racing
dct_description_sm: designed, prepared and published by Robert E. Rader, Jr.
Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian
Includes index to race courses, illustrations, text, and insets of "Race courses within the reaches of Washington and Baltimore," and "Race courses metropolitan area."

Text describing "The Great American Eclipse - Sir Henry match, an important early race over the Union Course L.I., New York, May 27, 1823" with illustration, and maps of 26 race courses with text in border
Each inset racetrack has individual description, legend, and compass rose

Racetracks as insets around map edge, clockwise from upper left: [1] Keeneland in Lexington, Kentucky -- [2] Turf Del Mar Club in Del Mar, California -- [3] Santa Anita Park in Arcadia, California -- [4] Arlington Park in Chicago, Illinois -- [5] Washington Park in Homewood, Illinois -- [6] Hollywood Park in Inglewood, California -- [7] Pimlico in Baltimore, Maryland -- [8] Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky -- [9] Empire City in Yonkers, New York -- [11] Garden State Park in Camden, New Jersey -- [12] Narragansett Park in Pawtucket, Rhode Island -- [13] Suffolk Downs in East Boston, Mass. -- [14] Rockingham Park in Salem, New Hampshire -- [15] Laurel Park in Laurel, Maryland -- [16] Hialeah Park in Hialeah, Florida -- [17] Aqueduct in Queens County, New York -- [18] Belmont Park in Elmont, Long Island -- [19] Saratoga in Saratoga Springs, N.Y. -- [20] Jamaica in Jamaica, Long Island -- [21] Hippodromo de las Americas in Mexico City, Mexico -- [22] Woodbine Park in Toronto, Canada -- [23] Delaware Park in Stanton, Delaware -- [24] Havre de Grace in Havre de Grace, Maryland -- [25] Detroit in Detroit, Michigan -- [26] Hawthorne in Stickney, Illinois -- [27] Lincoln Fields in Crete, Illinois
